title: tecoma lepidota
intro: Tecoma lepidota, commonly known as Yellow Bells, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is valued for its vibrant yellow flowers and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Tecoma lepidota include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
